title: The Silo Problem
lines: Enterprise data has been siloed for decades;
this was a consequence of SaaS software economics.
But today agents need access to all of our information to be effective.
And this demands a new data and security model.
text: Enterprise data has been siloed for decades; this was a consequence of SaaS software economics. But today agents need access to all of our information to be effective. And this demands a new data and security model.

title: Monolithic Agents
lines: Today we grant agents access to everything,
and we can’t see or control what they do with it.
This approach is risky, and simply doesn't work for agents that run continuously with evolving requirements.
text: Today we grant agents access to everything, and we can’t see or control what they do with it. This approach is risky, and simply doesn't work for agents that run continuously with evolving requirements.

title: ECHO Graph Database
lines: DXOS takes a fundamentally different approach.
Enterprise, team, and personal data all connect into a unified virtual semantic graph.
Composer brings it all together in an extensible super app, replacing dozens of separate vendors.
text: DXOS takes a fundamentally different approach. Enterprise, team, and personal data all connect into a unified virtual semantic graph. Composer brings it all together in an extensible super app, replacing dozens of separate vendors.

title: ECHO Hypergraph
lines: The graph is partitioned into interconnected workspaces;
enabling teams and agents to work within a secure shared context.
Workspaces are flexible containers, drawing in data from different sources as plans and tasks evolve.
text: The graph is partitioned into interconnected workspaces; enabling teams and agents to work within a secure shared context. Workspaces are flexible containers, drawing in data from different sources as plans and tasks evolve.

title: Open and Extensible
lines: Open by design, Composer lets teams and agents build and customize apps, plugins and skills.
And the entire stack runs on Cloudflare Workers, so it's secure, cost-effective, and scales on demand.
DXOS is the operating system for the new enterprise.
